Hildegard 0.1.17 is a pre-alpha. It fixes model downloads from Hugging Face redirects and makes Talk's speech more reliable.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Server (speech, always on):** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh -s -- --server`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update` (or `hildegard update all` for every device).

## Fixed

- **Downloads keep their size and checksum id.** When Hugging Face answers with a 307 redirect, Hildegard now keeps the
  resolve-cache size and git id, so resumed and verified downloads stay correct.
- **Voice decodes audio before Whisper.** Transcription reads audio through PyAV 19 first.
- **Voice falls back to the CPU.** If the CUDA cublas libraries are missing, speech switches to the CPU instead of
  failing, including when encoding happens late.
- **Steadier tests.** The CLI host tests use an ephemeral port, which fixes a race on Ubuntu, and the print-loop MCP
  test waits up to 180 seconds.
